details.summary: The incident began with a bad deployment of orders (v1.4.0) causing NullPointerExceptions. Following a rollback of orders, the inventory service suffered from database connection pool exhaustion and resource saturation. An attempt to migrate inventory to a new database endpoint ('postgres-primary') failed because the endpoint did not exist, causing the service to enter a CrashLoopBackOff.
proposals: Revert "inventory: move to the new primary database endpoint (#164)"
